_note: CANONICAL certificate layout geometry for the MATE ZONE CHESS ACADEMY template.
THE TEMPLATE
src/assets/certificate-template.png (1490x1055, A4 landscape). It is the
supplied artwork with the sample name 'Student Name' erased by
scripts/prepare-certificate-template.mjs, which rebuilds the background from
real pixels rather than painting a flat patch over it. Everything else in the
artwork — MATE ZONE branding, the tagline, CERTIFICATE / OF LEVEL COMPLETION,
the presentation and completion lines, the ornamented border, the corner
geometry, the level ribbon, the gold medallion, the large glass king, the
faded background pieces, the founder block and PLAY - LEARN - GROW — is part
of the image and is NOT redrawn by this module.
Only the DYNAMIC layer is laid out here, and every element that shows the
level appears exactly once, so no number is ever drawn twice or left ghosted
behind the ribbon.
COORDS
All values are TEMPLATE PIXELS of the 1490x1055 artwork. A4 landscape is
595.28pt, so 1 inch = 72pt = 127.6 px. 'y' is the TOP of the text box.
MEASURED LANDMARKS (from the artwork, not estimated)
script underline            y 530-531, diamond x 739-752
level ribbon interior       y 608-666, centre y 637, body #006E9D
medallion centre            (1297, 334), gold rim #DBC48A
medallion free band         y 288-330, x 1252-1342 (below crown, above stars)
description zone           y 690-815 (empty in the artwork)
bottom information band    y 815-890 (empty in the artwork)
founder block              y 929-977 (part of the image — do not overlap)
The frontend keeps a byte-identical copy at frontend/src/data/
certificateLayout.json; scripts/certificate-layout-parity.test.mjs asserts
they never drift. Edit the BACKEND copy, then run:
cd frontend && npm run sync:cert-layout
See CERTIFICATES.md.
